title: Ten Ton Hammer "Free Realms Beta" Giveaway
names_seen: Ten Ton Hammer "Free Realms Beta" Giveaway

facts.statement: Entries for the Ten Ton Hammer Free Realms Beta Giveaway could be submitted between April 17, 2009 and April 19, 2009, by confirming an email address.
facts.quote: Entries ... can be submitted between April 17, 2009 and April 19, 2009.

facts.statement: Winners were to be selected by random drawing on or before April 20, 2009, and contacted by email.
facts.quote: Winners will be selected via random drawing on or before April 20, 2009.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms Beta Giveaway Rules
article_summaries.summary: This is the official rules page for a Ten Ton Hammer contest giving away Free Realms closed beta keys, run by Master Games International. It gives the entry window, winner-selection timing, and the entry-weighting for Ten Ton Hammer Premium Members versus registered users. It describes a pre-launch beta giveaway, not the running game.
